preconditions.description: Number of vertices n is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2 * 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All vertex values a_i are within the specified range.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices u_i and v_i are within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(dist(i, v) * a[i] for i in range(1, n+1)) for v in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible cost of the tree by choosing an optimal vertex v.
